headline: Petroperú Reports US$144.9 Million Net Income Through September 2026
summary: Petroperú reported a net profit of US$144.9 million for the period ending September 2026, reversing a US$355 million loss from the same period a year earlier.
why: State-owned oil company financial statements reflect sovereign corporate health and impact domestic energy supply and fiscal transfers.

impacts.why: The state oil company returned to profitability with significant net income.
